mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile moment: the slipping and grip adjustment brought touch, nerves and muscles together in a recognizable action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the surface cells and then adding the outer layer felt somewhat repetitive, although the results explained distinct roles.

surprise.text: The explanation that the outermost skin cells are dead while living cells beneath replace them added a detail I had not expected from the combination alone.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt particularly arbitrary; the item names and goals gave each a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be curious to see another chapter connect body systems to an everyday action, though the mostly obvious combinations made the decisions feel limited.
